captions: \textbf{Progressive \sca{} beside AReA and HRDiT at $4096^2$.} Sixteen Aesthetic-4K evaluation prompts. Every baseline image is at or above its method's 10th percentile of ImageReward. FLUX.1-dev, seed~0. AReA: 28 steps at $4096^2$. HRDiT and progressive \sca{}: HRDiT's schedule of 30 steps at $1024^2$, 17 at $2048^2$ and 10 at $4096^2$, progressive \sca{} with \sca{} attention in the last two stages. Each image is followed by a 1:1 crop of its outlined $%d\times%d$ window.
\textbf{Progressive \sca{} beside AReA and HRDiT at $4096^2$, continued.} Prompts nine to sixteen; same protocol as Figure~\ref{fig:gallery_prog16}.

prompts.prompt: Snow-capped mountains rise majestically above a serene lake, with lush green hills in the foreground and a winding road leading into the distance under a blue sky adorned with wispy clouds.
prompts.why: mountains, lake and winding road: clarity 4 of 5

crops.area: flat grey road with uniform grass and a fine lattice
crops.hrdit: a flat cartoon road with dashed lines and vector leaves
crops.prog: crisp double yellow line, white edge lines, textured gravel shoulder and trees

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: honeycomb-like fine grain in meadow and lake (3x); fine striation on hazy rock; faint x~2113 sky line

prompts.prompt: A diver in a black wetsuit uses a spear while swimming above a vibrant coral reef composed of various shapes and colors of coral, surrounded by clear blue water.
prompts.why: diver over a coral reef: clarity 3 of 5; HRDiT as crisp as ours in most other coral windows

crops.area: hazy reef with a crosshatch lattice and white speckle blobs
crops.hrdit: mostly soft hazy distant coral heads
crops.prog: crisp urchin corals with resolved polyps and textured rock

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: tiny pseudo-text on the tank label, harness tag and spear blade; small odd objects on the reef (a yellow gear-like disc, a cyan cube); branching bubble plume; reversed spear

prompts.prompt: A woman with blonde hair and red lipstick sits against a weathered structure, wearing a light-colored blouse and gold accessories, with lush green foliage in the background.

crops.area: flat grey wall with a fine diagonal lattice and two specks
crops.hrdit: soft wall and a ringed finger
crops.prog: crisp ornate gold bracelet with specular beads and wrist tendons

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: thin dark contour with a green fringe along the out-of-focus sleeve edge

prompts.prompt: Rolling green hills under a clear blue sky, dotted with patches of mist and purple heather, feature a solitary tree and a weathered stone wall.
prompts.why: green hills with a tree and a stone wall: clarity 4 of 5

crops.area: flat green field with a faint lattice
crops.hrdit: soft dark hillside with blurred tufts

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: faint light rim on the wall top and fine grain on stone faces (4x); distant small trees and shrubs read as scenery (as in UltraImage and HRDiT)

prompts.prompt: A chaotic battle scene featuring various fantasy characters, including an armored orc, ethereal figures, a menacing dragon-like creature, and dark sorceresses, all engaged in intense combat amongst a backdrop of ruins and ominous lighting.

crops.area: murky dark skin of its own orc, grain, no structure
crops.hrdit: a different region (a forearm with a leather bracer), moderately sharp
crops.prog: sharp face with stubble, wrinkles, glowing eye and individual teeth

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: 4 px dark line on the right border; bright halo rims on dark shapes against fog; illegible rune-like belt engraving; stylised feet and boots

prompts.prompt: A starry night sky features the Milky Way arching above a tranquil lake, surrounded by silhouettes of tall trees and swampy vegetation in the foreground.
prompts.why: Milky Way over a lake: clarity 4 of 5; HRDiT's hatch may be stronger than its usual; alternative window (520, 1400)

crops.area: flat sky with an obvious diagonal stripe lattice
crops.hrdit: starry sky covered by a diagonal hatch
crops.prog: crisp pine top with individual needle tufts on a clean sky

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: fine diagonal weave over the bright Milky Way core (clear at 4x); stars drawn as small five-point glyphs; tiny specks on the water

prompts.prompt: A woman with sleek, pulled-back hair and elegant eyeglasses gazes thoughtfully to the side, adorned with multiple pieces of intricate silver jewelry against a muted, textured background.
prompts.why: woman with glasses and jewellery: clarity 3 of 5; advantage clear against UltraImage only; HRDiT has a watermark-like K logo in its corner

crops.area: smeared out-of-focus skin with faint vertical streaks
crops.hrdit: plain shoulder skin with pores, sharp
crops.prog: crisp faceted centre stone and clean pave setting

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: 2-4 px light halos at the glasses frame and finger outlines; fingerprint-like ridges on the back of the hand; possible echo arcs on the far-eye lashes

prompts.prompt: A serene winter landscape featuring a snowy waterfall cascading into a turquoise pool, surrounded by icy rocks and a blanket of snow under a cloudy sky.

crops.area: blank sky over a flat snow plain with dark specks
crops.hrdit: crisp icicles over a brick-like rock grid
crops.prog: distinct crisp tiered icicles with snow caps

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: faint x~2117 vertical line (about 1 level) in sky and snow; 1.9-level step at y 768 in sky; cut-out rims at snow-water edges

prompts.prompt: A serene landscape featuring abstract, dark-colored mountains and vivid blue water beneath dramatic, swirling clouds, illuminated by bright beams of light streaming from above.
prompts.why: fjord with light beams: clarity 4 of 5

crops.area: flat blue haze with faint vertical stripes, no structure
crops.hrdit: stylised wavy rock texture with white speckles
crops.prog: crisp moss-streaked cliff faces with white surf at the waterline

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 or overview-subtle: 2-4 px light halos on dark silhouettes (read as rim light); two straight white bars on the water (tiny dashes at print, read as glints); dotted shore foam; faint canvas micro-texture in sky and water

prompts.prompt: A muscular, bald man holds a flower above his head with both arms, set against a soft circular background in black and white.
prompts.why: bald man holding a flower (drawing): clarity 3 of 5

crops.area: striped background behind a smeared sprig

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: glossy glove-like hands (no countable finger error at print); spiky nipples; wavy lower chest contours; a target-like ring at the flower centre; sparkle flecks in the beard

prompts.prompt: Towering rock formations rise from a sandy landscape under a star-filled sky, with the Milky Way visible in the background, showcasing a blend of earthy tones and celestial beauty.
prompts.why: rock towers under the Milky Way: clarity 4 of 5

crops.area: flat sky with a vertical seam stripe above a talus slope with a mesh lattice
crops.hrdit: a crisp Milky Way star field (different content)
crops.prog: crisp rock ledges, boulders, a grass tuft and sand ripples

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: grid-locked 8/16 px mesh (0.8-1.6 levels) in the starry sky with smudgy faint stars; soft dark blobs in the Milky Way; a short streak reads as a meteor

prompts.prompt: A woman in an orange jacket climbs a treacherous rock face, using ice axes, with snow and ice swirling around her.
prompts.why: climber on ice: clarity 3 of 5; AReA's rock wall is covered in multicoloured polka dots (speckle at its extreme)

crops.area: a crisp boot with white snowflake dots (different content)
crops.hrdit: blurred teal ice and a rope

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: small pseudo-text on strap labels, patches, boot and axe (unreadable at print); white halos along the rope, beanie and profile; a blurred word-like smudge in the background

prompts.prompt: A young man in a white shirt and green tunic sits on a stone, using a measuring tool, while two standing figures, one in red robes with a turban and another in a yellow cloak, observe him against a backdrop of trees and a distant landscape.

crops.area: soft green robe fabric with a fine lattice
crops.hrdit: staff and robe hem before distant mountains, moderately soft
crops.prog: hazy but structured fields, hedgerows, tree rows and small white houses

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: waxy highlight smears on robes; rubbery bark; 2-3 px bright line on the left border; a modern wristwatch on one man (also in UltraImage)

prompts.prompt: A lone hiker stands on a rocky outcrop, overlooking a stunning landscape of dramatic mountains and a serene, reflective body of water at sunset, with vibrant hues of orange, pink, and purple in the sky.
prompts.why: lone hiker at sunset: clarity 4 of 5; AReA and HRDiT each have a tiny extra figure outside the window

crops.area: lake reflection with blocky horizontal streaks and haze
crops.hrdit: slope and shoreline over flat dark water, soft
crops.prog: scree texture, small pine clusters, a crisp shoreline and turquoise shallows

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: 1:1 only: diagonal 16 px checker (1-2.6 levels) on dark foreground rocks; 2-3 px bright halo along ridgelines; tiny pseudo-text on the backpack badge; a faint pink disc reads as a cloud puff

prompts.prompt: A bald man with a beard wears a textured, dark purple garment and a thick, black neckpiece, bowing his head slightly against a misty background.
prompts.why: bald bearded man: clarity 3 of 5; advantage clear over UltraImage only

crops.area: its own brow and eye with odd whitish lashes
crops.hrdit: crisp beard curls, an ear and a knit scarf
crops.prog: dense crisp crow's-feet wrinkles and individual lashes

prompts.progressive_audit: CLEAN: anatomy correct, no pseudo-text; sub-visible steps of at most 1 level on 256 px grid lines

prompts.prompt: A gnarled, ancient tree stands on rugged terrain under a starry night sky, with the Milky Way stretching across the backdrop.
prompts.why: gnarled tree under the Milky Way: clarity 3 of 5; dark crops; HRDiT equally crisp

crops.area: thin branches against a sky with a fine crosshatch lattice
crops.hrdit: crisp rock with gravel and plants
crops.prog: forked roots with fine bark grain

prompts.progressive_audit: MINOR: from round 1: squirrel-like silhouette on a branch stub; faint light halos on dark edges; grain in the bright Milky Way; stylised roots (all 1:1)
